scripts.install:all: bun install && bun install --cwd backend && bun install --cwd frontend
scripts.dev: bunx concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "bun --cwd backend develop" "bun --cwd frontend dev"
scripts.build: bun --cwd backend run build && bun --cwd frontend run build
scripts.start: bunx concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "bun --cwd backend run start" "bun --cwd frontend run start"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun --cwd frontend run check
